translations.web: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city, and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David, and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
